## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive (mixed). SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling confirm subdued volatility while sector breadth and mixed sector signals keep the regime neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling. Credit/financials neutral-to-recovering: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) → flat and XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) ↓ falling and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) → flat; dollar and yield-curve indicators show no directional bias (NEUTRAL).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Rotation into Energy and select cyclicals: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ↑ rising and XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ↑ rising, while Tech is in CORRECTION: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) ↓ falling — style: cyclicals edging growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US modest outperformance: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%). EM mixed: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +2.66%) → flat and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: -2.05%) ↑ rising.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto/large-cap spec flows strong: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +26.16%) ↑ rising and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +31.35%). Thematic/speculative dispersion: ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +14.39%) → flat; IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -1.53%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity-led move: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ↑ rising and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) ↑ rising; base metals soft as CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%) → flat. Precious metals in profit-taking: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +5.28%) ↓ falling and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +7.99%) ↓ falling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clear leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ↑ rising, supported by BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +7.70%) → flat.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%). MAJOR DIVERGENCE across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT) — XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%), XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%), TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) — suppresses a strong directional call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy and selective cyclicals (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%); XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%)) while reducing exposure to weak small-cap/tech beta (IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -1.53%); XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ↑ rising; Communications/Health for breadth follow-through: Comm. sector (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +5.51%) and Healthcare XBI note (XBI CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +7.43%)). BEARISH: Industrials XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.33%) ↓ falling and Materials XME signal (XME CORRECTION alert) — watch downside momentum.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/WTI via BNO/USO ABOVE TREND (BNO 1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%; USO 1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) ↑ rising. BEARISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%) → flat.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling; HYG/LQD parity ~ watch 0.80 for credit stress (HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) → flat; LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) → flat); XLK/XLF spread — monitor XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) ↓ falling vs XLF RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ↑ rising.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, with Energy and select cyclicals showing strength. Key risk is major divergence across core ETFs (SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT) — monitor tech weakness and small-cap softness for regime shift.
